description: This file contains unit tests for the user search and autocomplete functionalities within the Mattermost server, specifically testing user retrieval with various filters, restrictions, and input formats.

classes.name: SearchTestHelper
classes.description: Helper class for setting up user search tests, managing fixtures, and asserting results.

methods.name: TestSearchUserStore
methods.description: Main test function that initializes the test environment and runs all user search related tests.

methods.name: testGetAllUsersInChannelWithEmptyTerm
methods.description: Tests retrieving all users in a channel with an empty search term, including limit and restriction handling.

methods.name: testHonorChannelRestrictionsAutocompletingUsers
methods.description: Tests that channel restrictions are honored during user autocomplete.

methods.name: testHonorTeamRestrictionsAutocompletingUsers
methods.description: Tests that team restrictions are honored during user autocomplete.

methods.name: testShouldReturnNothingWithoutProperAccess
methods.description: Verifies that users without proper access do not retrieve users outside allowed channels.

methods.name: testAutocompleteUserByUsername
methods.description: Tests user autocomplete functionality by username.

methods.name: testAutocompleteUserByFirstName
methods.description: Tests user autocomplete by first name.

methods.name: testAutocompleteUserByLastName
methods.description: Tests user autocomplete by last name.

methods.name: testAutocompleteUserByNickName
methods.description: Tests user autocomplete by nickname.

methods.name: testAutocompleteUserByEmail
methods.description: Tests user autocomplete by email.

methods.name: testShouldNotMatchSpecificQueriesEmail
methods.description: Ensures specific email queries do not match unintended users.

methods.name: testAutocompleteUserByUsernameWithDot
methods.description: Tests autocomplete with username containing dots.

methods.name: testAutocompleteUserByUsernameWithUnderscore
methods.description: Tests autocomplete with username containing underscores.

methods.name: testAutocompleteUserByUsernameWithHyphen
methods.description: Tests autocomplete with username containing hyphens.

methods.name: testShouldEscapePercentageCharacter
methods.description: Verifies escaping of percentage characters in search.

methods.name: testShouldEscapeUnderscoreCharacter
methods.description: Verifies escaping of underscore characters in search.

methods.name: testShouldBeAbleToSearchInactiveUsers
methods.description: Tests searching for inactive users.

methods.name: testShouldBeAbleToSearchFilteringByRole
methods.description: Tests filtering users by roles.

methods.name: testShouldIgnoreLeadingAtSymbols
methods.description: Ensures leading '@' symbols are ignored in search queries.

methods.name: testSearchUsersShouldBeCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Verifies case insensitivity in user search.

methods.name: testSearchOneTwoCharUsernamesAndFirstLastNames
methods.description: Tests support for short usernames and names with two characters.

methods.name: testShouldSupportKoreanCharacters
methods.description: Tests support for Korean characters in search.

methods.name: testSearchWithHyphenAtTheEndOfTheTerm
methods.description: Tests search with hyphen at the end of the term.

methods.name: testSearchUsersInTeam
methods.description: Tests searching users within a specific team with various filters.

methods.name: testSearchUsersByFullName
methods.description: Tests searching users by full name.

methods.name: testSearchUserBySubstringInAnyName
methods.description: Tests substring search in user names.
